mapper.insert: insert into user_presence_visits(user_id, client_id, online_at, last_seen_at) select id, #{clientId}, #{now}, #{now} from users where id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE' on duplicate key update last_seen_at = greatest(last_seen_at, values(last_seen_at))
mapper.update: update user_presence_visits set offline_at = least(#{now}, timestampadd(second, #{timeout}, last_seen_at)), end_reason = if(timestampadd(second, #{timeout}, last_seen_at) <= #{now}, 'TIMEOUT', 'CLOSED') where user_id = #{userId} and active_client = #{clientId}
mapper.select: select count(distinct user_id) from user_presence_visits where offline_at is null and last_seen_at > #{cutoff}

select user_id, max(offline_at is null and last_seen_at > #{cutoff}) online, max(online_at) last_online_at, max(coalesce(offline_at, if(last_seen_at <= #{cutoff}, timestampadd(second, #{timeout}, last_seen_at), null))) last_offline_at from user_presence_visits where user_id in #{id} group by user_id
select count(*) from user_presence_visits where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into daily_online_users(user_id, online_date, first_seen_at) values (#{userId}, #{onlineDate}, #{firstSeenAt})
